question: Does the unchanged selected BOUNDARY2 complete policy improve practical W1 whole-game strength over the exact accepted factual-clock comparator at10+0.1?
admission: Fresh confirmation is conditional on passing current semantic/integrated validation, the complete outcome-blind timing diagnosis and a fresh exact-actor native owner-CPU delivery calibration. No historical unqualified score may be opened. Negative reproduction does not establish the historical cause; the new study must independently satisfy every qualification gate. No remedial Search/JVM/priority patch or relaxed25ms ceiling is used.
actors: Exact immutable SR034 runtime-production-v2 native build74 core AND UCI versus runtime-candidate-v2 build76 BOUNDARY2, matched Cp64SpendingUciMain launcher. CP64 S6CNU002/eight heads, BT4_Q_LOGIT400_V1, flags3407871, ADAPTIVE16, Hash64. Full runtime inventory plus file digests, network, JDK21 executable/VM/modules/configuration, runner, scripts, protocols, selected inputs and prerequisites are bound before games. No diagnostic JFR bridge or altered engine classpath is used in strength games.
policy: hard=min(2*base, remaining-50), nominal=ceil(hard/2); completed ordinary depth>=6 stable3 may stop at ceil(nominal/2), otherwise first completed boundary>=nominal. No changed-move extra iteration. Hard/node/external stop precedence retained. No retuning or alternate finalist.
sampling: Uniform random sample without replacement from sorted unique eligible source-book final-position keys in partition1, using the frozen seed. Preserve eight-full-move histories and color reversal. Exclude all available tracked prior selection manifests, including closed SR034 confirmation, all existing development exclusions and every prefix/root of the new14 diagnostic histories. Freeze all192 openings and six consecutive32-pair partitions before play; no evaluator/outcome filtering or reselection.
model: Opening pairs are the sampling units; each pair score is the mean of two color-reversed game scores. Representative independent-pair inference is approximate: shared opening families and persistent JVM/host states may induce dependence. Unique held-out roots, paired colors and fresh processes per block mitigate but do not prove absence of bias. No universal platform/clock/worker inference.

analysis.looks: Exactly one final look after all six blocks and prerequisite receipts qualify; no interim scores, futility look or sample extension.
analysis.primary: Paired mean and sample variance with n-1; SE=sqrt(variance/192), two-sided95% normal interval mean +/- NormalDist.inv_cdf(.975)*SE clipped to[0,1]. Positive support only if lower>.5; negative if upper<.5; otherwise inconclusive. Zero variance gives no primary normal conclusion. Report W/D/L, pentanomial and logistic Elo400log10(p/(1-p)).
analysis.sensitivity: Report bounded-pair Hoeffding95% radius sqrt(log(40)/(2*192)) and logistic Elo endpoints. If it crosses equality, state clearly that this conservative sensitivity does not independently establish superiority. Shared sampling assumptions still apply. Also report each operational block's pair-mean dispersion after the single authorized final opening, descriptively without new tests or selection.
analysis.rationale: A design target of approximately +/-50Elo normal95% precision near equality, under worst bounded-pair variance.25, needs ceil((z*.5/(logistic(50)-.5))^2) pairs; round up to the next complete32-pair block:192. The worst-variance normal approximation has about80% power for roughly72Elo improvement, not a promised effect or minimum required gain. This materially discounts the selected historical development point estimate; the old unqualified scores supply no information. The resulting fixed384-game study is about3h15 at measured serial throughput including qualification. No positive point estimate alone warrants adoption.

clock: Both actors must qualify. All64 games per block end normally with legal histories, complete whole-request nodes, valid pair provenance, no flags/crashes/stale outputs and owned process drain. Audit every runner clock conservation equation from10100ms, actual clock charge, hard allocation and pre-increment reserve. Report minima, low clocks, incomplete work and soft stops. No tolerance increase, adverse-request exclusion or post hoc causal forgiveness.
stopping: Stop confirmation on any started-block integrity/clock/resource failure or interruption, preserve all evidence, and do not open strength. No replay, replacement block, unfavorable-opening deletion, threshold change or extension. Unstarted failed admission may retry identical inputs in a distinct attempt at least15min later. Qualified blocks resume only with unchanged identities/evidence, no unclosed predecessor and fresh availability checks. Operationally incomplete/unqualified is not negative strength evidence. A technical analysis/receipt failure may be repaired transparently against the same immutable capture, without changing arithmetic, qualification, sample or outcomes; preserve failed endpoint and separate repair evidence.
adoption: Positive primary evidence plus full timing/resource/correctness qualification may justify promotion-ready shared-BaselineEngine integration and proportionate worker1-16/consumer qualification. Actual costs, conservative sensitivity and domain limits must be reconciled. Explicit post-evidence GPT/owner acceptance still precedes production-default activation.
